name: recomaze
description: Prepare useful marketing and sales work from your business data in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
When you don’t have time to sell, let ChatGPT review your pipeline, flag buyers waiting on you, and draft your most pressing follow-up. Bring your customer list into your CRM and set up a morning sales brief. You’ll see who needs your attention, what you promised them, and what you can say next.

Hand over the daily sales review

Choose when you want your brief. ChatGPT checks what changed, which commitments are due or overdue, and which deals have no next step. If you promised a buyer a product comparison by Thursday, that deal comes back into view when it’s due. Review the draft, send it yourself, and save the buyer’s answer. The next brief picks up from there.

Find your next sale in the customers you already know

Import unlimited contacts and review open opportunities by stage. When you introduce a product or service, ask which customers have mentioned the problem it solves. ChatGPT can show you the saved notes behind each suggestion and use your catalog to help you decide what to offer.

Give your team the same customer history

Save your company profile and connect your product catalog once. After a call, ask ChatGPT to record what the buyer needs, update the deal, and assign the next step with a due date. A teammate with access can pick up the same deal in their own chat, with the latest notes and product details. You don’t have to forward the conversation or explain the deal again.

Use what you learn in sales for marketing

When buyers keep asking the same question, use your catalog and company profile to turn the answer into an FAQ, a clearer product description, or a social post in your brand’s voice. If you have a connected website chatbot, you can also see which visitor questions went unanswered.

Manage several businesses in one chat

If you run multiple businesses, work at an agency, or freelance for several clients, ask which opportunities need attention across the websites you manage. See the results grouped by business, each with its own customers, catalog, and brand voice. The morning routine can prepare a separate brief for up to five websites per run.

Account access

Connect a Recomaze account to manage unlimited contacts and work with your team. Scheduling availability depends on your ChatGPT account.
capabilities: Daily brief with actions to approve
defaultPrompt: Take care of my daily sales review. Every morning, show me who needs attention and draft my most pressing follow-up.
Where are my next sales opportunities? Show me the open deals and customer notes behind your suggestions.
Which buyers have asked about this product or the problem it solves? Draft a reply using our catalog.

positive.prompt: What matters today for my business?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns today's brief for the connected website: what changed since the last run, the sales steps due, the content ready, what the agents propose and one useful thing to do, with nothing written or spent on its own.

positive.prompt: Which leads need a follow-up today?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the CRM steps due today or overdue, each with the person, the lead and its stage; drafts a follow-up on request and never sends it.

positive.prompt: List the prompts Recomaze tracks for my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the brand's tracked buyer prompts with their category and language.
Returns the chatbot's colors, texts, position and switches as last saved.

positive.description: A paid action waits for confirmation
positive.prompt: Run an AI visibility scan for my brand.
positive.expected_behavior: The first call returns the cost and needs_confirmation without running; after the user confirms, the call with confirmed=true starts the scan and returns a job id.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
Write me a poem about autumn.
Delete all my articles right now.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: 1.1.39: Updated the sales CRM description and the three starter prompts for daily follow-ups, sales opportunities, and catalog-based replies.
